subject: E-Commerce
title: The Network Effect Moat
description: Learn The Network Effect Moat in one minute.

hook.text: eBay had the network effect in 2000. Amazon broke it by subsidizing sellers to switch. Money can beat network effects.

buildup.text: Network effects seem unbreakable: the biggest marketplace has the most buyers, which keeps attracting sellers.

discovery.text: Amazon offered lower fees, FBA warehousing, and massive traffic to lure eBay's top sellers. Many switched.

twist.text: Temu and TikTok Shop are now subsidizing sellers away from Amazon. The same playbook works against any leader.

climax.text: Network effects are strong but not permanent. A richer competitor willing to lose money on acquisition can always.

punchline.text: eBay's moat fell to Amazon. Amazon's moat faces Temu.

quiz.question: How did Amazon overcome eBay's network effect?
options: Subsidizing sellers with lower fees, warehousing, and traffic to lure them away
